name: Naples
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Naples?
seo_title: Naples golf cart map and LSV map
answer_short: Only where the city or county has designated it. Florida lets golf carts use only roads a local government has designated and signed. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. US 41, SR 84, SR 951 and I-75 are off limits.

rules.rule: Only on roads a county or city has designated and signed
Registered LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Naples?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and tagged. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on US 41 in Naples?
faq.a: No. US 41 is a state highway that is not designated for carts, and Florida limits LSVs to roads posted 35 mph or less. The map only lets you cross it.

faq.q: Can a plain golf cart drive on Naples streets?
faq.a: Only on roads the city or county has designated and signed for golf carts (F.S. 316.212).
